list: The official 55 trophies as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026): 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden. Names, descriptions and grades are the official text; the guides are this entry's own words.

list_sources.name: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list
list_sources.note: Official names, descriptions, grades and hidden flags, as reported by Push Square on 18 Nov 2026

list_sources.name: PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophy list
list_sources.note: Agrees with Exophase on every name, description and grade

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. It is the last trophy by design, so treat it as a finish line, not a task: work through the roadmap stages below and it unlocks on its own. No multiplayer or DLC is needed; all 54 are single-player. Source: the official list (Exophase / PSNProfiles) for the requirement, and PowerPyx for the roadmap that leads to it.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. Play the first main mission of Chapter 1, Gone Fishing, to its end and it pops. This is the opening mission, so every player earns it within the first stretch of the game. Source: PowerPyx, which lists it as the first main mission in Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish every main mission of Chapter 1; it unlocks as the chapter closes, when the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, begins. Just follow the pink main-mission icons. Source: PowerPyx, which places the unlock at the start of Chapter 2.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Play through Chapter 2's main missions; it pops when the chapter ends and the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, starts. Chapter 2 is also where both Jason and Lucia become playable together, which opens up most of the side trophies. Source: PowerPyx, which places the unlock at the start of Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Chapter 3; it unlocks once you have completed the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Chapter 3 is where the big robbery systems open up — the Key Cloner, jewelry jobs and Randy's car list — so use the chapter to start those side lines. Source: PowerPyx, which places the unlock at the first two missions of Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete Chapter 4; it pops after the chapter's final main mission, Starting From Zero. Chapter 4 carries several mission trophies of its own (Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown), so by the time this one lands you will have collected those too. Source: PowerPyx, which places the unlock at the final Chapter 4 mission.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing the game's final mission — one of only two golds in the list. Play the story to its end; there is no branching choice to worry about for this trophy, and free-roam continues afterwards, so nothing else is locked behind it. Note the sources disagree slightly on the chapter: PowerPyx ties the finale to the closing mission of the story, while Output Lag places the final mission in Chapter 5. Either way, finishing the story is what pops it. Sources: PowerPyx and Output Lag.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks during the mission itself, so there is no way to miss it — just keep playing the story. Source: PowerPyx, which places Breakfast Run in Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. It is a main-mission trophy, so it pops as part of the story with no extra requirement. Source: PowerPyx, which places The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. Like every mission trophy, it unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed. Source: PowerPyx, which places Child's Play in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. It pops during the mission as the story plays out. Source: PowerPyx, which places Headliners in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown — the airport takedown that gives the trophy its name. It unlocks during the mission. Source: PowerPyx, which places VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. It is the last mission trophy in the list and pops during the mission itself. Source: PowerPyx, which places Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the list and the second gold. The 100% checklist unlocks after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — but progress made during the story already counts toward it, so start early. The requirements are forgiving: it is closer to 60% true completion, not a real 100%. You need any 100 optional missions (there are far more than 100), any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned with the WAiNK app, any 100 of 255 animals studied through the binoculars, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, all robberies, all underwater discoveries, all shooting ranges, all drone races and all of Bret's quests. Nothing toward it is missable and everything can be done in free-roam after the credits. Budget roughly 100 hours for this stage on top of a 60-80 hour story. Source: PowerPyx, which calls it the hardest trophy and lays out the lenient checklist.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Mix the kinds freely — only the total counts — and the under-the-bridge flights are the quickest to rack up. Track progress by region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots, where each stunt has its own name and stays marked once done. Note the 100% checklist needs 300 stunts, so keep going past 250. Source: PowerPyx, which breaks down the four stunt categories and the 397 total.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your coverage under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities — scrolling over a type shows how many you have done. The story introduces most of them on its own and the rest appear as you unfog the map (filter the map for Activities, the blue dumbbell icon). You will almost certainly earn this while working on the other trophies. Source: PowerPyx, which lists the 9 activity types and where to track them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges, spread across 12 shooting range locations. The gold-medal scores are not punishing — take your time, use a steady weapon and repeat a challenge until the gold threshold clears. Shooting ranges also level up your Focus stat, which helps with Gunslinger. Source: PowerPyx, which counts 12 ranges and 42 gold medals.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — there are 42 drone races in total, so you only need one win per location, not every race. Drone races also count toward the race win for Master of None. Learn each course's racing line on a practice run, then push for the win. Source: PowerPyx, which counts 14 locations and 42 races.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race location counts once, so you need 20 distinct wins, not 20 wins of the same race. There are 40 unique race locations, giving you twice as many to choose from as you need. Pick the shorter street circuits first and use a fast car you have tuned; car races, race challenges and drone races all sit in the same racing family. Source: PowerPyx, which counts 40 unique race locations.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you a fishing location marked with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal's fishing questline from there and beat him in the fishing challenge he sets. Fishing also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None. Source: PowerPyx, which traces the unlock to Cal's text after Feng Shui.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home by interacting with the controllers — available from Chapter 1 — while Bang For Your Buck lives on arcade machines around the world. To complete a game you must finish all of its levels at least once; you do not need to beat every challenge inside it. Pick whichever you enjoy most. Source: PowerPyx, which lists the 4 games and where each is played.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's optional questline is marked automatically in Chapter 3 and is exclusive to Lucia. While playing as Lucia you will get a call from Andy, then she texts her home address, marking the line on the map in Belville. Complete her 5 quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (join the Cellerica initiation), Read the Label (retrieve the Cellerica van), and Puff Puff Pass (meet at the warehouse). All of them stay available after the story. Source: PowerPyx, which lists Andy's 5 quests and the Lucia-only restriction.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's optional questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1. A while after the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams, where you work for Kenton, he calls you and is then marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you treasure diving: he marks purple chest icons on the map, you find the underwater treasures — use the metal detector to dig them from the ocean floor — and bring them back. After the first set he calls you back to his shop, then marks more; in total you clear 7 shipwrecks. Track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees, and under Progress, then Collections, then Kenton's Treasures. Kenton goes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3 (playing as Jason, calling Brian speeds it up). Source: PowerPyx, which counts the 7 shipwrecks and the Key Lento marker.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's optional questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his 5 quests: Thrillbillies (check out the mud club), Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab (join Billy on a job), Mall Rats (join Billy on a job), The Impaler (steal the Impaler), and Hometown Heroes (join Billy on a job). All of them stay available after the story. Source: PowerPyx, which lists Billy's 5 quests and the Coffee Break trigger.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers — but not every optional questline counts. The game does not count Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy or Eddie toward this trophy. The strands confirmed to count are Kirk (Skunk Ape: Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle, Buddy?), Yago (Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother), and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile: Passing the Torch, The Last Mile: Backseat Pilot, Pete's Deliveries and more). Strangers stay available in free-roam after the story, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows how many strands you have finished. PowerPyx notes more counting strangers are still being discovered. Source: PowerPyx, which names the confirmed counting strangers.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's optional questline, Randy's Wish List, is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy — that mission also unlocks the Key Cloner for breaking into high-end sports cars. Randy then wants 16 sports cars delivered; the Zorrusso is already delivered by the mission itself. Track the list under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List, and scan cars with the WAiNK app to check whether one is wanted — a popup tells you to deliver it when you enter one. Randy is marked by the green RK icon in the west of Vice City, and cars he marks appear in fixed spots (often around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, parked outside hotels). Delivering a car in good condition pays more. This stays available after the story. Source: PowerPyx, which lists the 16 cars and the Key Cloner unlock.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's optional questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty, and is only available as Jason. Purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs around Vice City — go to them and destroy them as part of the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. After enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives his second quest, Spin On This (shut down the labs), which unlocks the trophy. Everything stays available after the story. Source: PowerPyx, which traces the line from Here, Kitty Kitty through the lab destruction to the final quest.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY — read this before you finish Chapter 1. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and you can meditate as both Lucia and Jason at each spot, counting as +2 at the same location. Track them under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. The missable part: one meditation exists only in Chapter 1, at Jason's house. After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow and choose Accept while she shows you how. That meditation adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest, so it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy — PowerPyx earned the trophy having done it, and recommends doing it to be safe. You cannot do the final meditation until both characters are playable together (after Chapter 2's Coffee Break). For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 meditations are needed. Sources: PowerPyx (the Chapter 1 balcony meditation and the 18 spots) and Output Lag (which also flags this as the list's one missable trophy).
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's optional questline is marked at some point after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break. While playing as Jason you get a text from Bret marking his first quest, Veteran Hunted (meet Bret) in Lummox County — Lucia cannot receive the message, so this line is Jason-only. After that he marks hunting spots with purple icons: hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him as Jason. On the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. A clean one-shot kill leaves the animal pristine and pays more, but is not required. Track the hunts under Map, then Activities, then Target Deck — there are 15 Target Decks in total, all needed for the 100% checklist, so this trophy comes naturally along the way. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed. Source: PowerPyx, which traces the line from Bret's text to the Target Decks.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card set locations in total, so you have plenty of choice — finish the three sets whose cards you find first while exploring and doing other content. Cards are a collectible type, so check the collectible guides once the community maps every set. Source: PowerPyx, which counts 18 collectible card set locations.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations in the environment — hold Up, then R1, while looking at a scannable object. Any 100 count; there are more than 100 available, split across 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher tags. Scan as you travel and the silver pops naturally during exploration. The same app scans vehicles for Whip It Good, so the two trophies progress together. Source: PowerPyx, which breaks down the scan categories.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this trophy unlocks automatically on the way there — leave it for late in the run and pick the easiest remaining challenges. View and track them under Progress, then Challenges; scrolling over a challenge shows a Completed checkmark in the bottom right. Many complete naturally while you work on the other trophies. Source: PowerPyx, which counts 80 challenges with 50 needed here and 70 for 100%.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: The earliest you can do this is after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together. Call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle, then cause enough chaos to reach a 4-star wanted level and escape the red heat zone — the trophy pops after you drive out of the heat zone, not just out of the flashing search area. A fast sports motorcycle helps you cut through traffic; if a helicopter chases you, shoot it down. The easiest escape route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since the large bank vault robberies always trigger 4-star wanted levels. Source: PowerPyx, which gives the tunnel route and the Chapter 4 mission fallback.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters and call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle). With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row while keeping your wanted level active the whole time — you need to stay in the red/blue flashing wanted state, not the red heat state. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, and Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: loot a couple of items in each store and break the safe in the back room with sticky bombs. The pop is delayed about half a minute after leaving the 3rd shop, and if it does not unlock, hit a 4th shop and keep going. Source: PowerPyx, which gives the jewelry-store route and the delayed pop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The game has 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes). The fastest way is the WAiNK app on your phone — hold Up to open it instantly, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. Just stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by; scanning is enough, you do not need to drive the vehicles. Check your totals under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so this trophy comes automatically on the way. Source: PowerPyx, which counts 557 vehicles and the 200 needed for 100%.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots on enemies are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar under your health and stamina. First buff your focus — eat or drink, wash your face or shower at home, and consume Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to extend the focus time. Then line up 5 enemies — criminals at gang operations are the best targets — and drop them quickly without missing. Wear body armor from Ammu-Nation so you can step out of cover, and use an assault rifle like the Duke 556: full-auto and more accurate than pistols or SMGs. PowerPyx reports it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. It gets easier as your Focus levels up (4 levels, checked under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then Focus): raise it via shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, and you will likely reach Focus level 4 naturally. Source: PowerPyx, which gives the activation, the Adrenaline tip and the gang-operation targets.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it must be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not a plane sitting on the airfield. The easiest is the plane at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield and head straight for it; next to the boarding bridge are stairs with a door leading directly into the plane (you can also enter on foot through the terminal). Inside, go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip, take off and fly away. The pop is delayed — you must fly about 1 km (0.6 miles) from the airport. Source: PowerPyx, which maps the E3/E4 plane and the 1 km distance.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military Rhino tank. They are at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, standing in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate — or use the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance — climb into a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy pops. Expect heavy resistance on the base, so go in with armor and a plan to get out. Source: PowerPyx, which locates the tanks at Mile Zero Air Station.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. That unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and unlocks jewelry store robberies, which are then marked automatically in unfogged map areas with a green icon. Break into a store through the back door using the Snap Gun — the gadget stays in your inventory permanently. At a locked door you get the choice to kick it (which triggers the alarm) or use the Snap Gun for the stealth approach. Inside, go to the back room, find the note with the safe code, and use the code to loot the safe without being detected. A good location is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City. Source: PowerPyx, which gives the Snap Gun unlock and the Richardson location.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress and introduces bank vault robberies — you do the first one as part of the mission: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, watch a guard carry a briefcase of cash in and open the vault, then go in fast and rob it. You cannot carry all the cash alone, so bring your partner and hold Right to hand off a bag. After that quest, pay Yasmani (the fence from Chapter 3) $10,000 per tip about security vans — you must first finish his earlier quests, robbing 2 Payday Loans — and he marks the vans with a purple icon. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level: escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist needs all 8, so this silver comes automatically; each bank pays up to $205,000, making this the best endgame money-maker. Source: PowerPyx, which counts the 8 bank jobs and the $10,000 Yasmani tips.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easiest way is the same Chapter 4 optional mission as Maximum Withdrawal, That's Where The Money Is…: tailing the security van to the bank and robbing the vault counts as robbing an armored truck, and you will get this automatically while doing all 8 large bank jobs for the 100% checklist. To get it earlier, find armored trucks driving around Vice City near banks, block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open — then escape the red heat radius (a Pay 'n' Spray helps). Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests; Yasmani unlocks as a fence from the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. Source: PowerPyx, which gives both the mission route and the early sticky-bomb method.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible. Do this after the story when you have a plane and free time — the map unfogs as you fly, and it also reveals activity icons and collectible markers that feed the other trophies. Source: PowerPyx, which recommends the plane method for unfogging.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total and the 100% checklist needs all of them, so this trophy comes automatically on the way. Operations are marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track your coverage under Progress, then Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed in the bottom right. Source: PowerPyx, which counts 9 gangs and 39 operations.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH — no guide has established the exact unlock yet. The description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so the likely trigger is drinking at a bar or venue overlooking Ocean Beach, but PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown and Output Lag lists it among the trophies with no confirmed unlock method. Do not waste hours guessing: check the sources below for updates as the community pins it down, and try Ocean Beach bars and viewpoints while doing other content in the area. Sources: PowerPyx (unknown) and Output Lag (no confirmed method at launch).
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH — no guide has established the exact unlock yet. The description points to smashing your way out of a vehicle showroom, so the likely trigger is a showroom robbery or escape in a vehicle, but PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown and Output Lag lists it among the trophies with no confirmed unlock method. Watch the sources below for the confirmed method as players find it, and try showroom-related robberies while working on the other robbery trophies. Sources: PowerPyx (unknown) and Output Lag (no confirmed method at launch).
trophies.source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, one of the gang operations in Port Gellhorn. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which is marked automatically. Before going, buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation — you need them to destroy the safe. Inside, collect the 3 valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it open with sticky bombs). The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and killing the enemies is not necessary. It is not missable: if you do not get all 3 during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a while and you can return for the rest. Source: PowerPyx, which lists the 3 valuables and the respawn.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then select a character and scroll to Strength (the heart icon). You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Increase strength by working out — buy a membership at a fitness club (filter the map for Activities, the dumbbell icon; there are many across Vice City) or work out at home after the story. Always go together with your partner (hold Right and press Triangle to call them): while you actively work out with one character, the other automatically completes their training too, doubling your progress. Source: PowerPyx, which gives the max-strength requirement and the train-together trick.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Click the trophy in the trophy list to see your count out of 500. Turn on criminal profile notifications first (Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile = On): whenever you do something that affects your reputation, a little demon face appears on the right of the screen. The profiles run from Professional (finishing objectives and robberies stealthily, destroying evidence, clean escapes) through Hardened (incapacitating enemies without killing them) and Violent (killing enemies and civilians) to Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable, a permanent status from excessive violence — avoid Irredeemable, since cops then shoot on sight more often. This comes passively while you work on the other trophies and the 100% checklist; every robbery and enemy encounter counts. If you are still short at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car. Source: PowerPyx, which counts the 500 actions and lists the five profiles.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH — no guide has established the exact unlock yet. The description, 'Second time's the charm', suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt, and PowerPyx believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — but that is a lead, not a confirmed method. Do not grind blindly: watch the sources below for confirmation, and pay attention to any Payday Loans interaction that asks for a second try. Source: PowerPyx (currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue).

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH — no guide has established the exact unlock yet. The description, 'What the hell just happened?', points to witnessing something strange, and PowerPyx believes it comes from a UFO questline — but that is a lead, not a confirmed method. Keep an eye on the sources below as players confirm the trigger, and note any strange lights or encounters while exploring Leonida at night. Source: PowerPyx (currently unknown, believed to be from the UFO questline).

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH — no guide has established the exact unlock yet. The description, a melee drive-by, and PowerPyx's current belief point to knocking enemies over with a melee kick while driving a motorcycle — but that is a lead, not a confirmed method. Try melee attacks from a moving motorcycle against pedestrians or enemies once you are comfortable riding, and watch the sources below for confirmation. Source: PowerPyx (currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle).

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts — the total is cumulative across all robberies, not one delivery. First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. This comes naturally while doing all robberies for the 100% checklist: the bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 each, but they only unlock after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…. Source: PowerPyx, which gives the Credit Check unlock and the $250,000 cumulative total.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops — the total is cumulative, so everything you buy along the way counts. The fastest route is the expensive stuff: guns at Ammu-Nation, car mods, and tattoos. There are 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores to spend in. You will make most of this money back from robberies, especially the bank vaults. Source: PowerPyx, which lists the shop counts and the fastest categories.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (there are also 4 story-related garages, which do not count). Together they cost $160,000. Garages become available for purchase after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses): you get a notification that a new app, Vice City Real Estate, has been installed on your phone, and you buy the garages through that app. A quick way to fund them is robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4. Buying garages also adds parking spots, which you need to register vehicles for On the Spot. Source: PowerPyx, which counts the 8 garages, the $160,000 total and the Daily Driver trigger.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses), and it lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location. You need enough garages first — see Little Boxes — because each garage adds parking spots for registered vehicles. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and, in his garage, choose Respray and then Register. At first Moses only accepts vehicles without trackers; later, in Chapter 3, you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the bill down. Source: PowerPyx, which gives the Moses unlock and the tracker rules.
